name: Kamojang Terrain Demo
description: Offline 3D Terrain Proof-of-Concept for Mount Kamojang geothermal area, West Java, Indonesia

dem.source: Nextzen / Mapzen Open Elevation Tiles (SRTM & Copernicus DEM GLO-30)

dem_pipeline: CRITICAL PRINCIPLE: Elevation resampling must be performed on raw elevation rasters (Float32/Int16) BEFORE Terrarium encoding.
Terrarium bit-packing formula: elev = (R * 256 + G + B / 256) - 32768.
Averaging or bilinear filtering on encoded RGB pixels corrupts elevation channels (e.g. green channel rollover causes >120m errors).
1. Acquire DEM raster in EPSG:4326 or EPSG:3857 (e.g., Copernicus GLO-30 or SRTM 30m).
2. Warp/reproject raw elevation values to target tile grid resolutions (256x256 per tile at target zooms z11-z14) using bilinear or cubicspline on elevation data:
3. Encode elevation to Terrarium RGB using rio-rgbify with exact interval 1/256 and base -32768:
4. When tiling from encoded raster with gdal2tiles.py, specify --resampling=near to prevent color-averaging adjacent pixels:
5. Package tiles to MBTiles with SQLite: table metadata and table tiles (zoom_level, tile_column, tile_row, tile_data).
6. Verify decoded elevation: query sample pixels with (R*256 + G + B/256) - 32768 and assert diff against source DEM < 0.00390625m.
vector_pipeline: 1. Acquire OpenStreetMap vector tile extract for bounding box 107.70,-7.22,107.89,-7.09.
2. Generate MVT tiles for zoom 11-13 with Planetiler or tilemaker.
3. Package into vector.mbtiles with SQLite schema.
